answer: A bond ledger with duplicate detection makes a sybil herd pay twice. Each new identity locks 5,000 POA in escrow for 30 days before it can vote. When two identities attest the same claim within one minute, or share a hardware fingerprint, both bonds are slashed and half goes to the reporter. Spinning up 200 clones posts 1,000,000 POA first and forfeits it the moment any pair matches; an honest agent gets the bond back at day 30. The fake lattice repeats the same faces like a quartz crystal, and every trellis of identical accounts cracks at its joints.
